text: Hey Greywind! Here are some of my thoughts on your charts. Hopefully they answer your questions. There are some acronyms and terms that I'm not sure you've read about yet so I hope my notes aren't condescending. author: pipscout
text:
Hello Everyone,

Thanks for the great training and thanks in advance for the help. I marked caps with checks, drew shaded areas across the caps and began to label DBR's and RBD's.

This is for the first homework:

Homework: Mark at least 200 caps on your charts - there are so many to see that it won't take long. Draw a box from the cap to where price hit it later. Note how price approached the caps, and how it reacted. If price broke the cap, note what happened next. Was the cap still relevant?
